fields.climate: temperate, with rainfall heavier in summer than winter; cold winters
fields.terrain: mostly hills and mountains; wide coastal plains in west and south
fields.hazards: occasional typhoons bring high winds and floods; low-level seismic activity common in southwest; volcanism: Halla (1,950 m) is considered historically active; it has not erupted in many centuries
fields.resources: coal, tungsten, graphite, molybdenum, lead, hydropower potential
fields.farm: rice, vegetables, cabbages, milk, onions, pork, chicken, eggs, tangerines/mandarins, potatoes
fields.exports: integrated circuits, cars, refined petroleum, plastics, machine parts
fields.industries: electronics, telecommunications, automobile production, chemicals, shipbuilding, steel
fields.regions: 9 provinces, 6 metropolitan cities, 1 special city, and 1 special self-governing city
fields.legal: mixed system combining European civil law, Anglo-American law, and Chinese classical thought
fields.military: 18-29 years of age for voluntary military service for men and women; mandatory military service for all eligible men 18-35 years of age (typically served from 20-28 years of age)…
